intro.name: Sebastian Šanda
intro.title: Full-Stack Developer
intro.description: For almost 10 years I've been building web and mobile apps – from React and Next.js frontends to NestJS APIs with GraphQL and PostgreSQL. I've worked on projects for Koh-I-Noor Deutschland, Zoetis and the Mobile Phone Museum. AI is part of my daily development workflow.

about.content:
I got into development through graphic design and coding websites. Over time I moved to React, mobile apps and the backend, so today I can take an app from interface design to the API and the database. My design background helps – I understand designers and care about the details.

AI is part of my everyday work. I use Claude, Codex, Cursor and Grok for writing code, refactoring, tests and documentation, and I always review and test what they produce.

In my free time I take photos, edit videos and experiment with game development in Roblox Studio.

skills.hint: Highlighted technologies are the ones I use most.
